machine-infra/OPS-HEAL-RESTART.reason: a new invocation preserves the prior event and opens one improvement on the third signal

machine-infra/OPS-HEAL-DEAD-LOCK.reason: a dead ledger lock holder is reclaimed before a new heal event is committed

machine-infra/OPS-HEAL-CONCURRENT.reason: two independent heal processes commit two durable ledger rows

machine-infra/OPS-HEAL-PROVIDER-REFUSE.reason: a provider action is rejected before an unresponsive external call can run

machine-infra/WORLD-UNREGISTERED.reason: unregistered long-running processes on a host → one unregistered anomaly each; an owner world-actor line makes that row live (N → N-1)

machine-infra/WORLD-ZOMBIE.reason: watcher beating every k min: live → zombie past 2k min → live on one new beat (retire never)

machine-infra/WORLD-UNREACHABLE.reason: failed host probe keeps rows present/live, flags unreachable:host and names it in the digest line; clears when the host answers

machine-infra/WORLD-QUIET.reason: a re-sweep with no change appends exactly one world-sweep line per scope and zero declarations

machine-infra/HOSTFACTS-ROUTED.reason: host facts written each pulse route pregate through resource-facts (an unreachable host is gone, the HQ host never)

machine-infra/HOSTFACTS-MAINT-RESERVED.reason: a host in a maintenance window is written reserved (out of routing) although its probe is healthy; back in pool → healthy

machine-infra/HOSTFACTS-LEDGER-FAULT.reason: a missing / corrupt ledger → resource-facts defaults; a failed facts write returns 0 and never throws

machine-infra/HOSTFACTS-ON-CHANGE.reason: the 임대관 rewrites a host row only on a material change (quiet pulse = 0 rows)

machine-infra/RF-UNHEALTHY.reason: the guardian marks node-b unhealthy → every caller (kit ⊕ migrated call sites) stops picking it; healthy again → back

machine-infra/RF-MAINTENANCE.reason: minim5 under maintenance (owner off · RES policy reserved) → gone from every caller; back after

machine-infra/RF-PAID-NOT-APPROVED.reason: a paid VM is never routed (burst included) until OP approves it in the registry; revoked → gone

machine-infra/RF-LEDGER-DOWN.reason: corrupt ledger ⊕ garbage policy → defaults with «default used», no throw, never HQ for heavy work

machine-infra/RF-LEDGER-RECOVERS.reason: no ledger → defaults; first guardian host rows → ledger wins (new host joins · roles narrowed) without restart

machine-infra/RF-ALL-OUT.reason: every gate host unhealthy → pickHost «no host» with a reason per host; nothing lands on HQ or an unapproved VM

machine-infra/MAINT-ROTATION.reason: windows rotate over 4 hosts for 3 days — one out at a time · pool 3 · no cut overlap · every host ≥ 2 windows · nothing forced

machine-infra/MAINT-TIGHT-FORCE.reason: tight capacity defers a window at most twice, then forces it (one host at a time, cut window respected)

machine-infra/MAINT-CUT-WINDOW.reason: a due host waits out the cut window (03:00–06:30) — the first window opens at the literal expected time

machine-infra/MAINT-STEP-FAULT.reason: injected step failures (ssh error · throw · reaper crash) land in the digest; the window still begins and its state is saved

machine-infra/MAINT-WORLD-ROW.reason: maintenance state lives in the world row: draining/maintenance → out of host-pick; pool → back in

machine-infra/WORLD-CONTROL.reason: MK pause refused · failing bootout recorded failed (state unchanged) · OP pause → off · guardian resume → live; bootout/bootstrap over the actor host; four world-control lines, applied ones carry undo

machine-infra/WORLD-AUTOREG.reason: registerCronQuietly (schedule create hook) → the sweep sees the line → registered · live · owner = calling seat · 0 unregistered

machine-infra/KIT-HB-STALENESS.reason: 5 seeded beat streams (shuffled append order): staleness fresh/late/dead/missing equals the hand oracle at every probe, and judgeWatchers DEAD equals staleness dead

machine-infra/KIT-HB-ONE-TRUTH.reason: 5 seeds of out-of-order seat-loop signals plus lease renewals: the loop_signals mirror row equals the beats.jsonl truth (at, health, lease) for every loop

machine-infra/KIT-HB-WATCHER-VIEW.reason: 5 seeds: an idle seat (loop-signal beat) never shows in the watcher view; a stopped watcher is OK at exactly 2x cadence and DEAD one minute later

machine-infra/WT-EPHEMERAL-ELIGIBLE.reason: a clean merged inactive worktree idle over 48h is classified as a candidate without deletion

machine-infra/WT-EPHEMERAL-ACTIVE-PTY.reason: an active PTY excludes the candidate and records the reason

machine-infra/KIT-HB-FAIL-SOFT.reason: 5 seeds: an unwritable ledger never throws from beat(); emitSignal reports the failed truth write and leaves no mirror row
